name: stackdome
description: Agent skills for deploying and managing applications on Stackdome, a self-hosted PaaS.

interface.description: Deploy and manage applications on Stackdome.
interface.longDescription: Teaches the agent to work with Stackdome, a self-hosted PaaS, across the full CLI: installing and authenticating, authoring a stackfile from the current repo, deploying and verifying a release reached a healthy state, checking status and tailing logs, debugging failed builds or crashing apps, managing secrets and environment variables, provisioning Postgres databases and volumes, inspecting or rolling back releases, and tearing a stack down.
capabilities: Install and authenticate the Stackdome CLI
Author and validate a stackfile from an existing repo
Deploy an application to a Stackdome instance and verify it reached a released, healthy state
Check status, tail logs, and debug failed builds or crashing apps
Manage secrets, environment variables, Postgres databases, and volumes
Inspect release history, roll back, and tear down a stack
interface.defaultPrompt: Deploy this repo to my Stackdome instance.
